role: Declares the per-world ChunkProviderGenerate state (terrain noise, surface state, seed) and provide_chunk, the raw generation pipeline for one overworld chunk.

structs.name: chunkgen
structs.java: ChunkProviderGenerate's noise generators and surface fields, built once per world

notes: Structure generators are excluded: they only record a pending start and place blocks in populate. struct chunkgen.owed marks a provider that owes world_insert_chunk's skipped generations; chunkgen_init clears it (lane suitestart, 2026-09-25).
